myStories.title: Storytime
myStories.introTitle: Turn a child's drawing into a lasting story
myStories.intro: Upload a child's drawing and AI will create a custom story and a beautiful cover. Edit the text if you like, then record the story in your own voice. After review, it will be published in the app under your name.
myStories.step1: Choose the child's drawing from gallery or camera.
myStories.step2: Review the suggested story text and cover, and edit if needed.
myStories.step3: Record the story in your own voice.
myStories.step4: After approval, the story is published under your name.
myStories.createCtaDesc: Upload a drawing and create a story
myStories.dailyLimit: You can upload a drawing and create an AI story only once per day. Try again tomorrow.
myStories.dailyLimitCtaDesc: Come back tomorrow to upload a new drawing
myStories.empty: No stories yet. Use the button above to begin.
myStories.loginNeeded: Sign in to create a story
myStories.loginHint: Sign in with your mobile number. If you don't have an account yet, we'll create one so your story can be published under your name.
myStories.logoutDesc: You can sign back in anytime
myStories.displayNameHint: This name appears on published stories
myStories.pickHint: Choose from gallery or take a photo so we can create the story and cover.
myStories.permissionDenied: Gallery or camera permission was denied
myStories.generating: Creating story text and cover from the drawing...
myStories.fallbackCover: Used the drawing as a simple cover
myStories.readyToRead: I'm ready to read it myself
myStories.readyToReadDesc: Save the text and continue to recording
myStories.recordHint: Read the script aloud and record — then preview before sending.
myStories.startRecordDesc: Turn on the mic and read the story
myStories.stopRecordDesc: Finish recording and listen to the preview
myStories.previewHint: Send it if you like it, or record again.
myStories.sendForReviewDesc: Your story and voice will go to admin for approval
myStories.saving: Saving audio and submitting for review...
myStories.done: Great! Your story was submitted for review. After approval, it will be published under your name.
myStories.recordFailed: Could not start recording. Try again
